Pikabot is a malware family commonly used to gain remote access to infected systems and deliver other malware.
pivot technique
A pivot is an investigative move where one clue is used to find another related clue, such as moving from a domain to linked IP addresses.
pivoted technique
Pivoted means an attacker used one compromised system as a stepping stone to reach another system or network.
planner agent concept
An AI agent that breaks a broad goal into smaller tasks for other software or agents to perform.
Planner and worker agents concept
Coordinated automated software agents in which some plan tasks and others carry them out.
Platform Security Processor product
The Platform Security Processor is a dedicated chip in some AMD systems that handles security functions such as cryptography and trusted boot operations.
plugins concept
Plugins are add-on pieces of software that extend what an application or website can do.
PolinRider threat-actor
PolinRider is a named threat actor, malware, or activity label referenced in security reporting.
port 443 protocol
Port 443 is the standard network port commonly used for secure web traffic over HTTPS.
Post-compromise activity technique
Post-compromise activity is what attackers do after they have already broken into a system.
PostgreSQL product
PostgreSQL is a database system used to store and manage data.
PostgreSQL 18.6 product
PostgreSQL 18.6 is a specific release of the PostgreSQL open-source database system.
PostgreSQL Global Development Group organization
The PostgreSQL Global Development Group is the community organization that develops and maintains the PostgreSQL database software.
prepare technique
An npm package lifecycle script stage that can run commands while a JavaScript package is being prepared or installed.
Previdian organization
Previdian is a named organization, product, or service referenced in security reporting.
Prioritization concept
Prioritization means deciding which issues or tasks should be handled first based on importance or risk.
private data concept
Sensitive information that should not be publicly disclosed, like personal identifiers or financial records.
Private information concept
Private information is personal or confidential data that should not be shared without permission.
Privilege escalation technique
A technique where someone gains more system access or permissions than they were originally allowed.
Privilege escalation flaw vulnerability
A privilege escalation flaw is a vulnerability that lets someone gain more access rights than they should have.
privilege-escalation technique
Privilege escalation is when an attacker gains higher levels of access than they were supposed to have.
also: N-central privilege escalation weakness
privileged access concept
Privileged access is a higher level of permission that lets a user or system make important changes or view sensitive information.
privileges concept
Privileges are permissions that determine what actions a user or process is allowed to perform on a system.
Probe technique
A probe is an attempt to test a system for weaknesses or useful information before an attack.
Probes technique
Automated checks sent to systems to discover services, versions, or possible vulnerabilities.
process injection technique
Process injection is a technique where malicious code is placed inside another running program to hide or gain its permissions.
processor concept
A processor is the main chip in a computer that runs instructions and performs calculations.
processor core concept
A processor core is an individual computing unit inside a CPU that executes program instructions.
production environment concept
A production environment is the live system that real users or customers depend on, unlike a test environment.
Prompt concept
A prompt is the instruction or question a person gives to an AI system to guide its response.
prompt injection technique
Prompt injection is a way of giving an AI system instructions that may make it behave in unintended ways.
prompting technique
Prompting is the practice of giving instructions and information to an AI model to guide its response.
prompts concept
Prompts are the instructions or questions a user gives to an AI system to get a response.
Public GitHub Repositories concept
Public GitHub repositories are code projects that anyone on the internet can view and copy.
pull request concept
A pull request is a request to review and merge code changes into a shared software project.
also: PR, PRs
pull requests concept
Pull requests are proposals to merge code changes into a software project, commonly used on platforms like GitHub.
QBase product
QBase is software used to plan, manage, and control drone missions.
qilin
Qilin is a ransomware group that steals data and encrypts victim systems for extortion.
Qilin ransomware group threat-actor
The Qilin ransomware group is a cybercriminal group known for ransomware attacks that encrypt data and demand payment.
QR concept
QR usually refers to a QR code, a square barcode that phones can scan to open links or store information.
QR code concept
A QR code is a square barcode that people can scan with a phone to open a link or share information.
QR codes concept
QR codes are square barcodes that a phone camera can scan to open a link or read stored information.
also: qrs
Qualcomm organization
Qualcomm is a technology company known for mobile processors, wireless chips, and communications technology.
Qualys organization
Qualys is a cybersecurity company known for cloud-based vulnerability management and compliance scanning tools.
Qualys Web Application Scanning product
A Qualys product for finding security weaknesses in websites and web applications.
also: WAS
Quantum Systems organization
Quantum Systems is a German company that makes unmanned aerial systems, including reconnaissance drones.
quarantined concept

queues concept
Queues are ordered waiting lines for tasks or messages that computer systems process one at a time or in sequence.
race condition vulnerability
A race condition is a bug where software behaves unpredictably because two operations happen in an unexpected order or at the same time.
ransom demands concept
Ransom demands are requests from criminals for payment, usually in exchange for restoring access to stolen or encrypted data.
ransomware concept
Ransomware is malicious software or an operation that locks or steals data to pressure victims into paying money.
also: ransomware lockers, ESXi ransomware, ESXi lockers

A ransomware attack is when criminals lock files or systems and demand payment to restore access or prevent data leaks.
ransomware attacks technique
Ransomware attacks are incidents where attackers use software or methods to disrupt access and demand payment.
ransomware campaign concept
A ransomware campaign is a coordinated set of attacks where criminals encrypt or steal victims' data and demand payment.
ransomware group threat-actor
A ransomware group is a criminal or threat-actor team that uses malware to lock or steal data and demand payment.
ransomware groups threat-actor
Ransomware groups are criminal teams that use ransomware or data theft to extort victims for money.
ransomware operation concept
A ransomware operation is a criminal effort that encrypts or steals data to extort victims for payment.

A ransomware payload is the part of an attack that encrypts or locks data and demands payment.
Ransomware Victims concept
Ransomware victims are people or organizations whose data or systems have been locked or threatened by ransomware attackers.
Rapid7 organization
A security firm providing vulnerability management, orchestration, and incident detection products like InsightVM and Metasploit.
Rapid7 InsightVM product
A Rapid7 vulnerability-management product that scans computers and networks for security flaws.
Rate limits technique
Rate limits are rules that restrict how many requests a person or program can make in a set time.
also: rate limiting
reachability concept
Reachability means whether one system, account, or network location can access another.

Reachability analysis checks whether a vulnerable or risky piece of code can actually be reached and triggered in a real application.

A widely used open-source JavaScript library for building user interfaces, maintained by Meta.
Readiness concept
Readiness is the state of being prepared to perform a task, job, or mission effectively.
real-time deepfake injection technique
A technique that inserts a fake AI-generated face, voice, or video feed into a live session.
recommendation concept
A recommendation is suggested guidance or an action that someone should consider taking to reduce risk or solve a problem.
reconnaissance technique
Reconnaissance is the information-gathering step attackers use to learn about a target before trying to break in.

Recover means restoring systems and business operations after a cyber incident.
recovery phrase concept
A recovery phrase is a list of words used to restore access to a cryptocurrency wallet if the device or app is lost.
also: existing recovery phrase, old phrase
recovery phrases concept
Recovery phrases are lists of words used to restore access to a cryptocurrency wallet or other secured account.

Recovery-phrase theft is the stealing of the secret backup words used to restore access to a cryptocurrency wallet.
Recruiting concept
The act of finding and persuading people to join an organization or activity.
Red Hat organization
Red Hat is a technology company known for enterprise Linux and related software.
Red Hat Quay product
A Red Hat product for storing, managing, and distributing software container images.
red team frameworks tool
Collections of tools used to simulate attacks during authorized security assessments.
redirect concept
A redirect sends a browser or request from one web address to another.
Redirected technique
Sent automatically from one website address or page to another.
regression concept
A regression is a new defect that makes something stop working after a change or update.
regulator concept
A regulator is an organization that oversees and enforces rules in a specific area.
regulators organization
Regulators are government or official bodies that create and enforce rules for industries and organizations.
regulatory compliance concept
Regulatory compliance means following laws and rules that apply to an organization or industry.
remediation technique
Remediation is the work of fixing a security problem and reducing the damage it caused.
remediation efforts concept
Remediation efforts are the actions taken to fix security problems and reduce the damage or risk from an incident.
Remediation workflows concept
Remediation workflows are planned steps for fixing security issues after they are found.
remote access concept
The ability to connect to another computer or network from a distant location and use it as if you were physically present.
Remote access portal product
A web service that lets users connect to an organization's systems from outside its network.
remote access tool tool
A remote access tool is software that lets someone control or manage a computer from another location, which can be legitimate or abused by attackers.

Malware that lets attackers remotely control an infected computer and often steal data from it.
also: RATs

A method of sending system log messages to a separate server so they remain available if the original machine fails.
also: centralized logging, SIEM logging

Remotely is a remote administration tool that can be used to access and manage computers over a network.
repositories concept
Repositories are places where software project files and related development data are stored.
repository concept
A repository is a storage location for code, files, and their change history, especially in systems like GitHub.
Requests per minute concept
Requests per minute is a measure of how many times users or systems ask a service for something in one minute.
researchers organization
Researchers are people who study systems, threats, or vulnerabilities to understand and improve security.
Reseller Network concept
A reseller network is a group of businesses authorized or used to sell another company's products.
resellers organization
Resellers are companies or people that sell products or services made by another vendor.
resilience concept
The ability of an organization to anticipate, withstand, and recover from adverse cyber events and security breaches.
Respond technique
Respond means to take action after detecting a security issue, such as containing an attack or fixing affected systems.
Restart concept
A restart is turning a device or program off and then back on again to refresh it or apply changes.
Restore technique
Restore means to bring data, settings, or a system back to an earlier working state.
also: Restoring the old phrase, restore an existing wallet
restoring an existing wallet concept
The process of recovering a cryptocurrency wallet using its saved recovery information.
retailers organization
Businesses that sell goods directly to consumers.
Retention concept
The practice of keeping logs, records, or other data for a defined period so they can be reviewed later.
Retries concept
Repeated attempts by software to complete an operation after an earlier attempt failed.
Reverse Tunnel technique
A network connection created from inside a private network to an outside server, allowing external access back into the private system.
Reversibility concept
Reversibility is the degree to which an automated action can be undone if it causes harm.
Revoke technique
To cancel a credential, permission, or access key so it can no longer be used.
Rhadamanthys malware
Rhadamanthys is a malware family commonly used to steal passwords, cryptocurrency wallet data, and other information.
Risk score concept
A risk score is a number or rating used to estimate how dangerous, suspicious, or vulnerable something is.
risk_factors concept
risk_factors is a technical field name commonly used to list reasons something received a particular risk assessment.
Roblox product
Roblox is an online gaming platform where users create and play games and buy virtual items.
root concept
The superuser account on Unix and Linux systems that has unlimited control over the entire computer.
also: as root
root access concept
Having complete administrative control over a computer or network, allowing unrestricted system changes.
root privileges concept
Root privileges are the highest level of control on Unix-like systems, allowing a user or program to change almost anything.
root-level concept
Root-level means having the highest level of control over a device or operating system.
root-level access concept
Root-level access is the highest level of control on many systems, allowing someone to change almost anything.
root-level control concept
Root-level control means having the highest level of access on a Unix-like computer, allowing almost any change to the system.
Root-Level Privileges concept
The highest level of access on a computer, allowing someone to control nearly all system settings and files.
run code concept
To run code means to make a computer execute instructions written in a programming language.
runtime concept
Runtime is the period when a program is actively running, or the software environment it needs in order to run.
Runtime security concept
Runtime security means protecting and monitoring software while it is actually running, not just before it starts.

Runtime Sensors are software components installed on systems to observe activity while applications are running.
russia
Russia is a country frequently referenced in cybersecurity stories involving cybercrime groups, espionage, and government activity.
S3 product
S3 is Amazon’s cloud object-storage service, often used to store files, backups, logs, and website data.
also: anonymous S3 requests
SaaS concept
SaaS is software delivered over the internet as a subscription or hosted service instead of installed and managed entirely by the customer.
sabotage technique
Sabotage is deliberate damage or disruption meant to weaken an organization, system, or country.
safeguards concept
Safeguards are protections put in place to reduce the chance or impact of harm, misuse, or security incidents.
SAST concept

SCA concept
Software Composition Analysis, a technique that identifies open source components and their known vulnerabilities in a codebase.

A scam is a dishonest scheme designed to trick people into giving up money, information, or access.
scammers threat-actor
Scammers are people who trick others to steal money, information, or access.
scanner tool
A scanner is a tool that searches for information or problems automatically.
scanning technique
Scanning is checking computers, networks, or services to find what is reachable and what may be vulnerable.
scans concept
Scans are automated checks that examine software or related data for issues or information.
Schema Validation technique
Schema Validation is a security feature that checks whether incoming data follows an expected structure and format.
SCL concept
SCL is a spam confidence level score used to help decide how suspicious an email is.
also: SCL of 1
scope concept
scope defines what access, targets, or permissions are included in a security test, login request, or authorization grant.
ScopeWeaver tool
A security tool described as a rebranded version of the ARTEX reconnaissance platform.
Scoring concept
Scoring is the practice of assigning a number or rating to show how risky, important, or suspicious something is.
SCTPE malware
A Linux malware family designed to send and receive mobile-network SS7 and Diameter signaling traffic.
Search engines concept
Search engines are services like Google or Bing that find and list web pages and other online content.
search rankings concept

secure element product

Security awareness concept
Knowing about common cyber risks and safer ways to use technology.
Security flaws concept
Weaknesses or mistakes in software or systems that attackers may be able to exploit.

A Security Gateway is a device or service that inspects and controls network traffic to enforce security rules.
also: compromised gateway
Security Gateways product
Check Point firewall products that control and inspect network traffic entering or leaving an organization.
Security incident concept
A security incident is an event where systems, data, or accounts may have been attacked, exposed, or misused.
Security incidents concept
Security incidents are events that threaten the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of systems or data.
security leaders concept
Security leaders are people responsible for guiding an organization’s cybersecurity strategy and teams.
Security Management Server product
A Security Management Server is a central system used to configure, monitor, and enforce security policies across devices.
also: Management Server
security products concept
Software or hardware designed to protect systems from cyber threats, like antivirus or firewalls.
security professionals concept
Security professionals are people whose job is to protect systems, data, and organizations from security threats.
Security Programs concept
Security programs are an organization’s organized policies, tools, people, and processes for reducing cyber risk.
security risks concept
Security risks are possible ways that systems, data, or people could be harmed by accidents, weaknesses, or attacks.
security software product
Security software is software designed to protect computers, networks, or data from threats.
Security Systems concept
Security systems are tools and processes used to protect computers, networks, and information.

A security team is the group of people responsible for protecting an organization's systems and data.
security teams concept
Groups of professionals responsible for protecting an organization's information, systems, and networks from cyber threats.
security testing concept
Security testing is checking software, systems, or networks to find weaknesses before attackers can exploit them.
security tools tool
Security tools are software or hardware products used to detect, prevent, investigate, or respond to cyber threats.
security updates concept
Security updates are software fixes that close vulnerabilities or improve protection against threats.
SEGA organization
A Japanese video-game and entertainment company.
also: gaming giant Sega
seizure concept
A law-enforcement action that takes control of criminally used property, domains, or infrastructure.
Semiconductor concept
A semiconductor is a material used to make computer chips and other electronic components.
Semiconductor market concept
The semiconductor market is the global business sector that designs, manufactures, and sells computer chips.
Semiconductors concept
Semiconductors are materials and electronic components used to make computer chips.
sender concept
A sender is the person, account, server, or system that sends a message such as an email.
sensitive data concept
Sensitive data is information that could cause harm if exposed, such as passwords, financial details, or medical records.
sensitive information concept
Sensitive information is data that should be protected because exposing it could harm a person, company, or system.

Sensitive systems are computer systems whose access or data could cause serious harm if exposed or misused.
sensors tool
Devices or software components that collect data or monitor activity for analysis.

service account concept
A non-human account used by an application or service to perform automated tasks, often holding elevated privileges.

The process of preparing a device, application, or account for use.

The Shadowserver Foundation is a nonprofit internet security organization that scans for threats and shares data to help defenders protect networks.

shadowserver-foundation is a package name referenced in security reporting, likely impersonating or referencing The Shadowserver Foundation.

shell script tool

A threat-actor group referenced in security reporting for telecom-network spying activity.

Simeio is a cybersecurity company that provides security operations and identity-related services.
singapore
Singapore is a Southeast Asian country and technology hub often referenced in cybersecurity reporting.
skill concept
A voice-driven application that adds capabilities to a smart assistant like Amazon Alexa, similar to an app on a phone.

slack

SmartMail product
A corporate email service offered by ActiveCloud.

A Belarusian news organization.

socket organization
Socket is a software supply-chain security company that scans open-source packages for risky behavior.
software development concept
Software development is the process of designing, writing, testing, and maintaining computer programs.

Software flaws are mistakes or weaknesses in programs that can cause bugs or create security risks.
software maintainers concept
Software maintainers are the people or teams responsible for updating, fixing, and managing a software project.
software supply chains concept
Software supply chains are the many outside code packages, tools, services, and build steps that help create and deliver an application.
